claim: Kanye West was ahead of Biden and Trump in the Kentucky polls in October 2020
justification: The claim is refuted because the specific poll results showing Kanye West with 37% support have very low confidence (0.10) and are contradicted by high-confidence evidence (0.80-0.85) indicating that national polls showed West below 2% and that Trump had a large lead in Kentucky. The extraordinary nature of the claim, combined with the low-confidence and suspicious sources from the retrieval-based check, makes it unreliable, while the knowledge-based evidence aligns with well-documented election dynamics.
